name: CapitaLand Ascott Trust
summary: CapitaLand Ascott Trust (CLAS) is the largest lodging trust in Asia Pacific with an asset value of S8.8 billion dollar as of 30 June 2026. CLAS objective is to invest primarily in income-producing real estate and real estate-related assets which are used or predominantly used as serviced residences, rental housing properties, student accommodation and other hospitality assets in any country in the world. CLAS was listed on the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited (SGX-ST) since March 2006, and is a constituent of the FTSE EPRA Nareit Global Real Estate Index Series (Global Developed Index).
